description: Build an Alt-Svc response-header value (RFC 7838) from one or more alternative services, each a protocol-id (e.g. "h3"), optional host, port, max-age in seconds, and an optional persist flag, attaching a plain-English note for each well-known protocol-id.

host.description: Alternative host; omit to mean the same host

persist.description: Whether the entry should survive a network configuration change

name: build_alt_svc_header
